title: Apple CEO Tim Cook says the company is fighting 'a hundred-year flood' on memory pricing — expects to pay even more for memory in September following recent price hikes
summary: Apple held $5.93 billion of inventory at the end of June 2025 and $5.72 billion at its September fiscal year end, so the $11.09 billion reported for June 27 is a 94% increase in nine months.
